behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert relative path/query/fragment behavior remains unchanged.
Assert URL objects through buildMenu and original URL/item immutability.
docDelivery: Explain accepted URL/string forms and standard resolution/encoding behavior.
Document protocol validation, consumer output and no mutation/network operations.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Native WHATWG URL or strings; absolute http/https base and http/https result; frozen ordinary menu items; no network.
independence: Preserve base-path resolution and query/fragment behavior when adding URL-object input to existing string API.
